title: Germany 30-Year Bund auction (EUR 2.5bn across two reopening lines) — on FOMC day
source: EST: deutsche-finanzagentur.de English issuance calendar (/en/federal-securities/issuances/issuance-calendar), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 125,468 bytes) — the Quarter III 2026 table lists TWO 30-year reopening lines dated 16.09.2026: 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.0bn with the ISIN not yet specified, and 'Bund (R)' DE000BU2D012, coupon 2.90%, maturity 15.08.2056, at EUR 1.5bn. The same table carries 23.09.2026 (Bund 15 Y (R) EUR 1.0bn + Bund (R) DE000BU2T000 3.40% 15.05.2047 EUR 1.0bn) and 14.10.2026 (Bund 30 Y (R) EUR 1.5bn + EUR 1.0bn), recorded here and not filed since neither is adjacent to anything this calendar tracks. The Finanzagentur states that for multi-ISIN auctions in the 15/20/30-year segment the bonds to be reopened are specified only with the quarterly calendar update, which is why the EUR 1.0bn line carries no ISIN. Filed estimate on the same two counts as jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15 and ecb-decision-2026-09-10: market-events-data.ts defines no confirmed source prefix for a non-US sovereign debt office, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, checked 2026-09-08
notes: Discovered during the treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), extending the same test that filed jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15 one row earlier: is this ledger's 'synchronized global long-end' leg narrative or calendar? It is calendar, and it is now THREE sovereigns inside two sessions — the US 20Y reopening and Japan's 700bn-yen 20Y JGB both on 2026-09-15, then EUR 2.5bn of 30-year Bund on 2026-09-16, the FOMC's own decision day. Tiered `low` deliberately and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: no house playbook is rates-keyed, no tracked symbol carries euro-rates exposure, and the FOMC dominates any Bund spillover on that date. What the entry buys is attribution, the same service ecb-decision-2026-09-10 bought for 09-10 and jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15 for 09-15: a 09-16 long-end move is not automatically attributable to the Fed. Context from the sibling ledger rows: Bund 10Y 3.382% on 2026-09-08 near a 15-year high, 30Y Bund above 3.84% on 2026-08-31 (highest since 2011), with the ECB expected to hike 25bp to a 2.50% deposit rate on 2026-09-10 and ~2.7% priced by December. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
